where: Section 2, and repeated in Exam traps bullet 1
problem: The text says that reading 10 as back rake instead of side rake 'changes the wedge and the relief' (trap: 'changes rake and relief'). Swapping slots 1 and 2 changes only the two rake angles and therefore the wedge. The relief angles sit in slots 3 and 4 and are not affected by misreading a rake value. A student will memorize this wrong link between rake slots and relief slots.
fix: Write: 'Reading 10 as back rake instead of side rake puts the wrong value in the wrong rake slot, so the wedge and the chip flow direction change. The relief values in slots 3 and 4 are unaffected.' In the trap: 'Reading 10 as back rake instead of side rake changes which rake is which, and so changes the wedge.'

problem: The sentence says the tool has five parts, then lists six: shank, face, flank, nose, side cutting edge and end cutting edge. The count and the list do not match.
fix: Either write 'six parts' or list the cutting edges as one part: 'a shank, a face, a flank, a nose and two cutting edges (side and end)'.
